tools.name: get_vamp_plugin_descriptions
tools.description: Get full descriptions of specific Vamp plugins by their keys

results.description: For each requested item in the same order, the result or an object with an error message

description.description: The description of the plugin (name, maker, version, category, details, parameters, output, extra outputs, inputs, default state, programs, 'linkedTrackFeatures' and 'linkedTrackCountDescriptor'). If the output is a multitrack output (e.g. the pitches of a polyphonic analysis or the partials of a sinusoidal analysis), the 'linkedTrackFeatures' are the features of the outputs of its linked tracks with the default number of tracks (only the first one is a feature of the plugin list) and the 'linkedTrackCountDescriptor' defines the name, the range and the default value of the number of tracks. Creating a track with the first feature creates all the linked tracks. A parameter with 'isAlias' set to true is an alternative way of setting other parameters (e.g. a window size in samples that sets a window duration in milliseconds): it is not part of the default state and setting it modifies the parameters it represents.

tools.name: get_track_properties
tools.description: Query one or more properties of one or more tracks in a single call. Request only the properties needed: 'name'; 'type' (label for markers, value for lines, vector for matrix/spectrogram); 'description' (the plugin description of the track, large); 'parameters' (the parameter values by identifier, the values of the alias parameters ('isAlias' in the description of the plugin) are computed from the values of the parameters they represent); 'graphics' (the graphics properties supported by the track type, see 'set_track_graphics', colors are hexadecimal strings #RRGGBBAA); 'inputs' (the input track identifiers by input identifier); 'visibleInGroup' (the visibility of the track in its group); 'extraThresholds' (the thresholds used to filter the results by extra output); 'verticalZoom' (value and vector tracks: the ranges are expressed in values for value tracks and in bin indices for vector tracks); 'valueRange' (vector tracks: the global range is the range of values mapped to the colors of the color map); 'linkedTracks' (the tracks created with a multitrack plugin output, the outputs with 'linkedTrackFeatures' in their description, e.g. the pitches of a polyphonic analysis or the partials of a sinusoidal analysis: the number of linked tracks, its range and its default value, and the identifiers of all the linked tracks). The tracks that don't exist are reported as errors. The properties that cannot be retrieved for a track (e.g. 'valueRange' for a label track, or 'type' while the analysis is running) are reported in its 'propertyErrors' and the other properties are returned.

properties.description: The properties to query for each track

tools.name: set_track_properties
tools.description: Modify one or more properties of one or more tracks in a single call: 'name'; 'visibleInGroup' (the visibility of the track in its group); 'extraThresholds' (the thresholds used to filter the results by extra output, an empty array removes the thresholds); 'verticalZoom' (value and vector tracks: the visible range of the vertical zoom, expressed in values for value tracks and in bin indices for vector tracks, that can be clipped to the global range; the tracks with a linked zoom propagate the change to the other linked tracks of their group); 'valueRange' (vector tracks: the range of values mapped to the colors of the color map). The top-level properties are default values applied to all the tracks, the properties of a track override them. A track is not modified if one of its properties is invalid or not supported by its type and the error is reported, the other tracks are modified. The result contains the effective values of the modified properties. To modify the graphics, the parameters, the inputs or the number of linked tracks, use 'set_track_graphics', 'set_track_parameters', 'set_track_inputs' or 'set_linked_track_count'.

tools.name: set_track_graphics
tools.description: Set graphics properties for one or more tracks. The top-level properties are default values applied to all the tracks that support them, the properties of a track override the default values. A track is not modified if it doesn't support one of its own properties and the error is reported. Available properties depend on track type: label tracks (colorBackground, colorForeground, colorDuration, colorText, colorShadow, fontName, fontSize, fontStyle, lineWidth, labelLayoutPosition, labelLayoutJustification, markerStyle), value tracks (colorBackground, colorForeground, colorText, colorShadow, fontName, fontSize, fontStyle, lineWidth, unit), vector tracks (colorMap, unit). color values must be a hexadecimal color strings #RRGGBBAA (e.g. '#aabbccff') and colorMap values must be one of the following strings: 'Parula', 'Heat', 'Jet', 'Turbo', 'Hot', 'Gray', 'Magma', 'Inferno', 'Plasma', 'Viridis', 'Cividis', or 'Github'. Font style values must be one of the following strings: 'normal', 'bold', 'italic', or 'bold italic'. Label layout justification values must be one of the following strings: 'top', 'centred', or 'bottom'. Marker style values must be one of the following strings: 'bar' or 'underline'. The colorGradient distributes the colors of a color map over the tracks in the order of the tracks array (e.g. the linked tracks returned by the 'linkedTracks' property of 'get_track_properties') to create a gradient.

A track is not modified if it doesn't have one of its own parameters and the error is reported. The alias parameters ('isAlias' in the description of the plugin, e.g. a window size in samples that sets a window duration in milliseconds) are applied after the other parameters and modify the parameters they represent: don't set an alias parameter and the parameters it represents together. The tracks of the same multitrack output (see 'create_tracks_with_plugins') are linked and share their parameters: modifying the parameters of one of the tracks modifies all of them. The parameters don't change the number of linked tracks, use 'set_linked_track_count' instead.

tools.name: set_linked_track_count
tools.description: Set the number of linked tracks of one or more tracks created with a multitrack plugin output (the outputs with 'linkedTrackFeatures' in their description, e.g. the pitches of a polyphonic analysis or the partials of a sinusoidal analysis). The number is clamped to the range of the plugin and shared by the linked tracks: modifying the number of tracks of one of the linked tracks modifies all of them. The new tracks are added above the last linked track (as copies of it) and the linked tracks that no longer exist are removed (potentially the requested track itself). The linked tracks removed by the user are not created again. The result contains the new number of tracks and the linked tracks. The top-level linkedTrackCount is the default value applied to all the tracks, the linkedTrackCount of a track overrides it. The tracks that don't belong to a multitrack output are reported as errors.

tools.name: create_tracks_with_plugins
tools.description: Create multiple tracks from Vamp plugins. The tracks are created in order, each one at the top of its group (drawn in front of the other tracks, so the last created track is the top track), except the tracks of vector outputs (more than one bin, e.g. spectrograms) that are created at the bottom of their group (drawn behind the other tracks); use 'move_tracks' to change their positions afterwards. The tracks that cannot be created (invalid plugin, group or parameter) are reported as errors while the other tracks are created. IMPORTANT: minimize repetition by factoring shared values into the top-level global fields. If multiple tracks use the same plugin, groupIdentifier, linkedTrackCount or parameter value, specify it once globally and omit it from those tracks. Per-track fields are overrides and should contain ONLY values that differ from the global values. Global parameters are applied to every created track first, then per-track parameters override global parameters with the same key. A global parameter may be used even if no track explicitly declares that parameter. Prefer the most compact representation that preserves the requested configuration. If the output of a plugin is a multitrack output (with 'linkedTrackFeatures' and 'linkedTrackCountDescriptor' in its description, e.g. the pitches of a polyphonic analysis or the partials of a sinusoidal analysis), linked tracks are created together from the bottom to the top (the first track at the bottom, so the layout lists them from the last to the first): the result contains the first track and the other linked tracks, the parameters are applied to all the linked tracks and the name of each track is suffixed with its number. The number of linked tracks is defined by linkedTrackCount (the default number of the plugin if omitted) and can be changed afterwards with 'set_linked_track_count'. The alias parameters ('isAlias' in the description of the plugin) are applied after the other parameters and modify the parameters they represent.

plugin.description: Global default Vamp plugin shared by all tracks that omit tracks.plugin. IMPORTANT: if multiple tracks use the same plugin, define it here once and omit tracks.plugin from those tracks. Per-track plugin is only for tracks using a different plugin.

groupIdentifier.description: Global default group identifier shared by all tracks that omit tracks.groupIdentifier. IMPORTANT: if multiple tracks belong to the same group, define it here once and omit tracks.groupIdentifier from those tracks. Per-track groupIdentifier is only for tracks belonging to a different group. Defaults to the top group of the document.

parameters.description: Global default parameter values applied to every created track. IMPORTANT: factor out parameters that have the same value on multiple tracks into this array instead of repeating them in tracks[].parameters. Global parameters are applied first; per-track parameters with the same key override the global value. A global parameter may be used even if no track explicitly declares that parameter.

key.description: The identifier of the parameter to modify

linkedTrackCount.description: Global default number of linked tracks applied to every created track whose plugin output is a multitrack output (ignored for the other outputs). Clamped to the range of the 'linkedTrackCountDescriptor' of the plugin output. Defaults to the default number of tracks of the plugin.

tracks.description: Tracks to create. Use global plugin, groupIdentifier, and parameters whenever values are shared. Omit per-track fields when they match the global values. Per-track fields are overrides and should contain ONLY values that differ from the global configuration.

plugin.description: Per-track plugin override. Omit when the track uses the global plugin.

groupIdentifier.description: Per-track group override. Omit when the track uses the global group.

name.description: Optional custom name for the created track; defaults to the automatic plugin/feature name

parameters.description: Per-track parameter overrides. Include ONLY parameters whose values differ from the global values. A parameter with the same key as a global parameter overrides that global value for this track.

key.description: The identifier of the parameter to override

linkedTrackCount.description: Per-track number of linked tracks override (only if the plugin output is a multitrack output). Omit when the track uses the global value.

results.description: For each requested item in the same order, the result or an object with an error message

identifier.description: The unique identifier of the new track (the first linked track if the output is a multitrack output)

name.description: The name of the new track

linkedTracks.description: The other linked tracks created for the multitrack output of the plugin, from the second to the last (only if the output has several linked tracks)

identifier.description: The unique identifier of the track

tools.name: create_tracks_with_files
tools.description: Create tracks from analysis/result files. The tracks are created in order, each one at the top of its group (drawn in front of the other tracks, so the last created track is the top track); use 'move_tracks' to change their positions afterwards. The tracks that cannot be created (invalid file or group) are reported as errors while the other tracks are created.

groupIdentifier.description: Optional default group identifier applied when tracks.groupIdentifier is omitted. Defaults to the top group of the document.

file.description: Absolute path to the analysis/result file to import as a track

groupIdentifier.description: Optional group identifier that overrides the default group identifier

tracks.description: Tracks to create from associated files with optional per-track groupIdentifier override

results.description: For each requested item in the same order, the result or an object with an error message

identifier.description: The unique identifier of the new track

name.description: The name of the new track

tools.name: remove_tracks
tools.description: Remove one or more tracks. The tracks that don't exist are reported as errors and the other tracks are removed.

results.description: Map of track identifiers to a confirmation message for the items that succeeded

errors.description: Map of track identifiers to an error message for the items that failed

tools.name: move_tracks
tools.description: Move one or more existing tracks within their group or to another group (the tracks are not modified). The tracks are moved in order and the tracks that cannot be moved (invalid track, group or anchor) are reported as errors while the other tracks are moved. Only the requested tracks are moved: to move all the linked tracks of a multitrack output, list all of them. Several tracks moved with the same placement (same group, placement and anchor) are placed in the order of the array from the top to the bottom: to keep their current relative order, list them in the order of the 'layout' property of 'get_group_properties'. To reorder all the tracks of a group at once, prefer the 'layout' property of 'set_group_properties'.

groupIdentifier.description: Global default destination group of the tracks that omit tracks.groupIdentifier, for the 'top' and 'bottom' placements. Defaults to the current group of each track. Not necessary with the 'above' and 'below' placements (the group of the anchor track is used).

placement.description: Global default placement of the tracks that omit tracks.placement: 'top' (drawn in front of the other tracks of the group), 'bottom' (drawn behind the other tracks of the group), 'above' or 'below' the track anchorTrackIdentifier (in its group). The placement is required either here or per track.

anchorTrackIdentifier.description: Identifier of an existing track used as the anchor of the global 'above' and 'below' placements (required with them, not allowed with 'top' and 'bottom').

identifier.description: Identifier of the track to move

groupIdentifier.description: Per-track destination group that overrides the global destination group, for the 'top' and 'bottom' placements. Not necessary with the 'above' and 'below' placements (the group of the anchor track is used).

placement.description: Per-track placement that overrides the global placement and its anchor: 'top', 'bottom', 'above' or 'below' the track anchorTrackIdentifier (in its group).

anchorTrackIdentifier.description: Identifier of an existing track used as the anchor of the per-track 'above' and 'below' placements (required with them, not allowed with 'top' and 'bottom'), different from the moved track.

tracks.description: Tracks to move with their optional per-track destination groups and placements

results.description: Map of track identifiers to a confirmation message for the items that succeeded

errors.description: Map of track identifiers to an error message for the items that failed

tools.name: create_groups
tools.description: Create one or more new groups. The groups are created in order at their placement (at the bottom of the document by default, see 'placement') and the groups that cannot be created are reported as errors.

placement.description: Global default placement of the groups that omit groups.placement: 'top' (top of the document), 'bottom' (default, bottom of the document), 'above' or 'below' the group anchorGroupIdentifier. Several groups with the same placement (same placement and anchor) are placed in the order of the array from the top to the bottom.

anchorGroupIdentifier.description: Identifier of an existing group used as the anchor of the global 'above' and 'below' placements (required with them, not allowed with 'top' and 'bottom').

name.description: Optional name for the new group

placement.description: Per-group placement that overrides the global placement and its anchor: 'top', 'bottom', 'above' or 'below' the group anchorGroupIdentifier.

anchorGroupIdentifier.description: Identifier of an existing group used as the anchor of the per-group 'above' and 'below' placements (required with them, not allowed with 'top' and 'bottom').

groups.description: Groups to create with their optional names and placements

results.description: For each requested item in the same order, the result or an object with an error message

identifier.description: The unique identifier of the new group

name.description: The name of the new group

tracks.description: The tracks of the new group (empty)

tools.name: remove_groups
tools.description: Remove one or more groups with their tracks. The groups that don't exist are reported as errors and the other groups are removed.

results.description: Map of group identifiers to a confirmation message for the items that succeeded

errors.description: Map of group identifiers to an error message for the items that failed
